fusions.name: Overlap Charge
fusions.desc: Curls into a roll and rushes up to 6 tiles to the target, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Seam Lash
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 8 damage, with a 30% chance each of being [Damped] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Lapped Weave
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 35% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Layered Hem
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 stacks they all spend at once, giving you a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (46% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour is 6% higher.
